description: Flat metadata schema for individual registry records describing pediatric patients receiving radiotherapy for brain tumors, including demographics, tumor characteristics, radiotherapy exposure, treatment modifications, toxicities, interventions, and follow-up outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique registry record identifier for this patient-treatment episode; should be stable within the dataset.

patient_pseudonym_id.descr: De-identified patient identifier used to link repeated records for the same child across visits or treatment episodes.

site_id.descr: Registry site or hospital identifier where the patient was enrolled or treated.

country.descr: Country where treatment occurred or where the registry site is located.

sex.descr: Biological sex or sex recorded in the medical record; use controlled values such as female, male, intersex, or unknown.

age_at_radiotherapy_start_years.descr: Age at the start of radiotherapy in years; may be fractional for pediatric patients.

weight_kg.descr: Body weight at or nearest to radiotherapy start, in kilograms.

height_cm.descr: Body height at or nearest to radiotherapy start, in centimeters.

body_surface_area_m2.descr: Body surface area at treatment start, in square meters, if available.

race_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or clinically recorded race/ethnicity category, using local controlled terminology if possible.

date_of_birth.descr: Patient date of birth; use ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) if retained in a secure registry.

diagnosis_date.descr: Date of brain tumor diagnosis confirmed by pathology or imaging.

tumor_diagnosis.descr: Primary brain tumor diagnosis or entity name, such as medulloblastoma, glioma, ependymoma, or other.

tumor_histology.descr: Histopathologic classification of the tumor, if available.

tumor_grade.descr: Tumor grade or risk category according to the applicable classification system.

tumor_location.descr: Primary anatomic tumor location, such as cerebellum, brainstem, supratentorial, or ventricular region.

molecular_marker_summary.descr: Summary of relevant molecular or genetic markers, such as subtype, mutation status, or fusion status.

metastatic_disease_at_diagnosis.descr: Whether metastatic disease was present at diagnosis.

prior_surgery.descr: Whether the patient had surgery before radiotherapy.

prior_chemotherapy.descr: Whether the patient received chemotherapy before radiotherapy.

prior_other_cancer_therapy.descr: Whether the patient received other prior anti-cancer therapy before radiotherapy, such as targeted therapy or immunotherapy.

performance_status_score.descr: Baseline functional or performance status score recorded before radiotherapy, using a documented scale such as Lansky or Karnofsky.

comorbidity_summary.descr: Summary of relevant baseline comorbidities, neurologic conditions, or developmental issues.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Clinical intent of radiotherapy, such as curative, adjuvant, definitive, palliative, or salvage.

radiotherapy_modality.descr: Radiation modality used, such as photon, proton, electron, or mixed modality.

radiotherapy_technique.descr: Delivery technique used, such as IMRT, VMAT, 3D conformal, stereotactic, or craniospinal irradiation.

treatment_protocol_name.descr: Name or code of the treatment protocol or plan, if applicable.

target_volume_description.descr: Description of the planned target volume or irradiated region, such as whole brain, focal boost, or craniospinal axis.

prescribed_total_dose_gy.descr: Prescribed total radiation dose in Gray (Gy).

prescribed_dose_per_fraction_gy.descr: Prescribed dose per fraction in Gray (Gy).

actual_delivered_total_dose_gy.descr: Actual total dose delivered in Gray (Gy), if different from prescribed dose.

treatment_duration_days.descr: Total duration of the radiotherapy course in days from first to last fraction.

planned_treatment_days.descr: Planned duration of the radiotherapy course in days.

treatment_modification_occurred.descr: Whether any modification occurred during radiotherapy, such as interruption, replanning, or dose change.

treatment_modification_type.descr: Primary type of modification, such as interruption, delay, replanning, dose reduction, boost change, or adaptive replan.

treatment_modification_reason.descr: Reason for treatment modification, such as toxicity, machine failure, clinical deterioration, or anatomical change.

treatment_modification_days.descr: Number of days of delay or interruption attributable to treatment modification.

replanned_course.descr: Whether the plan was replanned during treatment.

boost_delivered.descr: Whether an additional boost dose was delivered.

acute_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any acute treatment-related side effect occurred during or shortly after radiotherapy.

acute_toxicity_type.descr: Main acute toxicity type, such as nausea, vomiting, fatigue, dermatitis, mucositis, headache, or edema.

acute_toxicity_grade.descr: Severity grade of the acute toxicity using the recorded grading system, commonly CTCAE grade 1-5.

acute_toxicity_onset_date.descr: Date acute toxicity was first documented.

late_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any late or delayed treatment-related side effect was recorded.

late_toxicity_type.descr: Main late toxicity type, such as neurocognitive decline, endocrine dysfunction, hearing loss, vision impairment, or radionecrosis.

late_toxicity_grade.descr: Severity grade of the late toxicity using the recorded grading system, commonly CTCAE grade 1-5.

neurological_outcome_summary.descr: Summary of neurologic outcome after treatment, including motor, sensory, seizure, speech, cognitive, or developmental changes.

cognitive_decline_present.descr: Whether measurable or clinically documented cognitive decline was reported after radiotherapy.

endocrine_sequelae_present.descr: Whether endocrine late effects such as growth hormone deficiency or hypothyroidism were reported.

vision_sequelae_present.descr: Whether visual complications were reported after radiotherapy.

hearing_sequelae_present.descr: Whether hearing loss or ototoxicity was reported after radiotherapy.

intervention_required.descr: Whether a subsequent intervention was required to manage toxicity or complications.

intervention_type.descr: Type of intervention required, such as medication, hospitalization, surgery, rehabilitation, steroid therapy, or shunt revision.

intervention_date.descr: Date the intervention was initiated or performed.

intervention_outcome.descr: Documented outcome after the intervention, such as improved, resolved, persistent, or unknown.

radiotherapy_discontinued_early.descr: Whether radiotherapy was stopped before the planned course was completed.

reason_for_early_discontinuation.descr: Reason for early discontinuation, if applicable.

tumor_response_assessment.descr: Best documented tumor response after treatment, such as complete response, partial response, stable disease, or progressive disease.

progression_or_recurrence_present.descr: Whether tumor progression or recurrence occurred during follow-up.

progression_or_recurrence_date.descr: Date progression or recurrence was first documented, if applicable.

subsequent_therapy_given.descr: Whether additional anti-tumor therapy was given after the index radiotherapy course.

subsequent_therapy_type.descr: Type of subsequent therapy, such as surgery, chemotherapy, re-irradiation, targeted therapy, or immunotherapy.

follow_up_date.descr: Date of the most recent clinical follow-up captured in the record.

follow_up_duration_months.descr: Time from radiotherapy start or end to most recent follow-up, in months.

vital_status.descr: Survival status at last follow-up, such as alive, deceased, or lost to follow-up.

cause_of_death.descr: Recorded cause of death, if known, such as tumor progression, treatment toxicity, or unrelated cause.
